research.question: Has the Student List named/filed its Speaker candidate; can verification and the Speaker vote be done the same day under the Rules; does SNS plan obstruction; why did 2022/2024 not elect on day one?
research.finding: No Speaker candidate named publicly as of 15 Nov 18:10 UTC (N1 and Vreme front pages scanned; no item). Faculties' plenums were still submitting proposals on 10 Nov (Faculty of Traffic proposed Prof. Aleksandar Čupić; 'the declaration of the plenums on the modality of election ... is in progress'); Student List says it has 'kadrovska rešenja' ready (Vreme 9 Nov). Rules of Procedure (Poslovnik, ch. II): verification is not a debated vote: a 3-member commission compares election certificates with the RIK report and the chair simply 'konstatuje' the confirmed mandates, then MPs take the oath. Speaker: proposal by at least 30 MPs filed in writing with the acting chair, then a debate (pretres) with no time limit stated in that chapter, then the Assembly decides secret vs public vote; public = roll call (prozivka) of all MPs; election needs a majority of all 250 (126). So nothing in the Rules prevents a same-day election, but the open-ended debate plus a 250-name roll call is where the 103 SNS-list MPs could stretch the sitting past midnight. Parties agreed on 13 Nov that voting should be public (dossier), so a roll call is likely. No new SNS obstruction statement found beyond Jovanov's 13 Nov 'we will respond accordingly' (dossier). Reasons for 2022/2024 delays: not found (no searches left); the dossier's caveat (SNS majority timed the Speaker vote to government formation) stays unverified.
